body: Introducing the White Pine Voyager, the ultimate adventure-ready custom camper van—a fully equipped Mercedes Sprinter 170, designed to be like home on the road. This van, built under our premium Zion build tier, combines cutting-edge technology with stylish aesthetics, providing unparalleled comfort and functionality for the modern nomad.

This van conversion boasts a robust 400W solar system paired with a 400Ah Lithium Iron Battery, ensuring you stay powered up wherever your journey takes you. With a 3000W pure sine wave power inverter/charger, multiple 110v electrical outlets with USB A&C, and a 30A shore power electrical plugin, you have all the electricity you need at your fingertips. The 50Amp DC to DC/solar charger combo ensures efficient energy management for all your off-grid adventures.

The Sprinter 170 features a 33-gallon freshwater tank and a graywater system, perfect for extended trips. The wet-bath style indoor shower, equipped with a cassette-style toilet and a 4-gallon electric hot water heater, offers the convenience of home. Additionally, the rear door outdoor shower provides easy access to hot and cold water after a day of exploring.

Cook like a pro in the custom-built kitchen featuring an Acacia butcher block countertop, an in-counter double burner induction cooktop, and a stainless steel sink with a stylish undermount design. The Isotherm Cruise 85 refrigerator with a built-in freezer ensures your food stays fresh while you’re on the go.

Stay comfortable in any weather with the basic insulation package, a Maxxair Deluxe ceiling vent fan with remote control, a Nomadic X2 12v AC unit, and an Espar diesel-powered cabin heater. This van is designed to keep you cozy and cool, no matter where the road leads.

The interior is a blend of rustic charm and modern elegance, featuring painted shiplap siding, a stained wood ceiling, and durable vinyl wood-style flooring. Storage is optimized with under-counter cabinets, a double-door cabinet, and two floor-to-ceiling closets with stick-on mirrors inside each top door. The headliner shelf adds even more space without sacrificing style.

This custom camper van is packed with thoughtful extras, including a removable bed system with a comfortable mattress, recessed dimmable LED ceiling lights, and swivel seats for the driver and passenger. The Broad Arrow 2 Seat Folding Bed offers additional sleeping space, while the magnetic blackout window coverings ensure privacy. Safety is prioritized with a carbon monoxide/smoke detector and a fire extinguisher on board.
